```{python}
import polars as pl
from IPython.display import Markdown

# 1. Daten aus Gold einlesen
df = pl.read_parquet("../data/gold/sensor_hourly.parquet")

active_devs = df["device_id"].n_unique()
total_samples = df["sample_count"].sum()
avg_temp = round(float(df["temp_avg"].mean()), 2)
```

## Stündliche Messwerte

```{python}
df_display = df.select(
    pl.col("window_start").dt.strftime("%d.%m. %H:%M").alias("Zeit"),
    pl.col("device_id").alias("Gerät"),
    pl.col("sample_count").alias("Samples"),
    pl.col("temp_min").alias("Min (°C)"),
    pl.col("temp_avg").alias("Ø Temp (°C)"),
    pl.col("temp_max").alias("Max (°C)"),
    pl.col("humidity_avg").alias("Ø Feuchte (%)"),
)

df_display
```

## Temperaturverlauf & 3h-Prognose

```{python}
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import polars as pl

df_plot = pl.read_parquet("../data/gold/sensor_forecast.parquet")

plt.style.use("seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid" if "seaborn-v0_8-whitegrid" in plt.style.available else "default")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4), dpi=120)

for (device_id,), group in df_plot.group_by(["device_id"]):
    # Historie (ist_forecast == False)
    hist = group.filter(~pl.col("is_forecast")).sort("window_start")
    ax.plot(hist["window_start"].to_list(), hist["temp_avg"].to_list(), marker="o", label=f"{device_id} (Ist)")

    # Vorhersage (is_forecast == True)
    fc = group.filter(pl.col("is_forecast")).sort("window_start")
    if not fc.is_empty():
        # Letzten Ist-Punkt für nahtlosen Linienübergang anhängen
        x_fc = [hist["window_start"][-1]] + fc["window_start"].to_list()
        y_fc = [hist["temp_avg"][-1]] + fc["temp_avg"].to_list()
        ax.plot(x_fc, y_fc, linestyle="--", alpha=0.8, label=f"{device_id} (Prognose)")

ax.set_ylabel("Temperatur (°C)")
ax.set_title("Temperaturverlauf & 3h-Prognose")
ax.legend(frameon=True)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```
